data-change-detection.title: Early detection of changes in organizational data

compliance-normalization.description: Python standardization of a database that used to be updated by hand: ~20 hours saved monthly, traceable and auditable data, KPIs available faster.

internal-ai-agent.description: Co-development of an agent in Copilot Studio used firm-wide; handles ~500 monthly queries.
